sources.title: MAHADEV - Diffusion_Model - Google Sites
sources.snippet: A diffusion model is a type of generative model that gradually denoises data starting from pure noise to generate realistic samples, such as images. It has gained popularity due to its high-quality output in image synthesis tasks.
